author: moltz
body: Hi, I was Banned Today for "hacking", Even Tho I was not. I was Banned for "AntiKnockBack". I claim that this is not true, and i think i should be unbanned, i was not hacking and if i was i did not know about it and was not aware. I am asking for another chance, if u catch me doing something "suspicious" u may perm ban me. I would really appreciate if u read this and understood that in my perspective i was not hacking, but if anything i was doing was fishy, i did not know. please give me 1 more final chance, this was probably my favorite server on mc and i would highly appreciate if u gave one extra chance to me.  -ShadowChubz :D
